headline: Britannia answers the first knock
lede: The nightly bot's step-1 stall was a half-loaded world advertising itself as ready. It only publishes when the map stands now — and a key pressed during the unroll sets the pilgrimage off the instant it lands.

notes.text: #2770 (30a79ac): __game/__britanniaTest/DebugKit publish at the end of load(), never at mount — the first sight of the contract is drivable (ready:true, first step advances one tick). The nightly #2769 signature is now a named mutant in britanniareadycheck (12 gates, mount-time publish puts 7 red).

Attract's law honours early arrivals: a key or tap that lands while Britannia unrolls arms the start — the game begins at the landing, held keys keep walking, stale one-shot taps drain. Prod-probed on jalfern.com with the map held on the wire.

Board: #2760 (FLOOR BOSS tail law) stays slot a's WIP resume; its drive-adjacent fallout was not touched. Filed #2772 for QA: britannidrive's walk/chapel legs fail identically at pristine main — gate-menu law drift since #2494/#2516, A/B verified, not a #2773 regression.
